items.evidence: data/talents/chronomancy/anomalies.lua:1723 and surrounding Anomaly Thread Walk doAction clone nearby actors; @Source@ is preserved and 两条时间线 accurately renders two threads.
data/talents/chronomancy/anomalies.lua:1947 and meteor callback create a falling meteor; @Source@ and the event meaning are preserved.
data/talents/chronomancy/anomalies.lua:1680 and makeParadoxClone create a hostile copy from another timeline; 邪恶双胞胎 follows the source's evil-twin idiom and preserves @Source@.
data/talents/chronomancy/anomalies.lua:1371 applies EFF_FLAWED_DESIGN to several targets, reducing resistances; 抗性下降 is accurate and @Source@ is preserved.
data/talents/chronomancy/anomalies.lua:485 applies EFF_BLINK to several targets; 不受控制地在空间中闪烁 matches the random blink effect and preserves @Source@.

data/talents/cunning/traps.lua:930 and repeated info builders append this suffix whenever trap_primed equals the trap id. The runtime behavior is immediate trigger for arbitrary trap types, not necessarily an explosion; 引爆 narrows the mechanism incorrectly. Markup is structurally intact.
data/talents/cunning/traps.lua:600 conditionally appends the exact prepared-trap cooldown notice; target meaning and #YELLOW#/#LAST# boundary are preserved.

data/talents/gifts/antimagic.lua:210-225 removes up to four is_spell sustains only when Antimagic Adept is known. The target's Mana Clash clarification is accurate in the containing info text and preserves #GREEN#/#LAST#.
data/talents/misc/horrors.lua:119 is a targeted bite talent; both @Source@ and capitalized @Target@ are preserved and the visible action is accurate.
data/talents/misc/horrors.lua:234 is the Void Madness targeted talent; both runtime tokens and the void-madness meaning are preserved.
data/talents/misc/misc.lua:216 emits this hate message for a sufficiently higher-level killed foe; 强敌 captures the actual experienced-foe condition and #F53CBE# is preserved.
data/talents/misc/npcs.lua:1451 projects LIGHT damage and kills the source; source/target tokens and searing-light meaning are preserved. ASCII punctuation is not a mechanism or markup defect.

data/talents/misc/npcs.lua:430,466,502 use the message for three melee attacks that only apply a disease after a successful hit. 传播疾病 erases the attack and overstates an application that can miss or be resisted; tokens are intact.
data/talents/techniques/unarmed-discipline.lua:135 is the block preparation talent; the target accurately describes preparing to block and preserves @Source@.
data/talents/techniques/unarmed-discipline.lua:31 starts Combination Kick, a flurry that can disrupt sustains; target is semantically adequate and preserves @Source@.

data/talents/uber/mag.lua:443 displays the short lich rebirth popup. 腐烂的只剩骨头 is grammatically wrong and changes 'starts to rot on your bones' into completed loss of flesh; 崩落不见 is also needlessly imprecise. #GREY# must remain unchanged.
items.proposed_target: #GREY#你感到生命逐渐流逝，取而代之的是纯粹的奥术力量！你的血肉开始腐烂，骨骼逐渐裸露，双眼也随之崩解；你重生为一名巫妖！

items.evidence: data/talents/uber/mag.lua:439 displays the same rebirth text plus the cosmetic choice. It shares F3's semantic/grammar defect, while 可以现在选择自定义你巫妖的外形 is conspicuously unidiomatic. The source intentionally opens #{italic}# to string end and has no #{normal}#; preserve that boundary.

items.evidence: data/zones/high-peak/grids.lua:184-206 transfers to the sanctum room and triggers Elandar/Argoniel interaction; portals, two wizards, and large room are all represented, with #VIOLET# preserved.

data/zones/high-peak/objects.lua:58-75 is a four-paragraph Staff of Absorption description. The target merges the first two source paragraphs, contains 的/得 and syntactic errors, weakens 'runes of power' and 'tarnish', and renders the lore in a conspicuously literal, awkward form. #{italic}#/#{normal}# are structurally intact and must stay paired.
items.proposed_target:
杖身铭刻着强大的符文。这根法杖似乎铸造于久远年代，却毫无锈蚀的痕迹。
它周围的光线仿佛也随之暗淡；仅仅触摸它，你就能感受到其中蕴藏的惊人力量。
巫师们似乎已经唤醒了它的力量。
#{italic}#“于是，他们来到阿马克泰尔本人面前。数千人在进攻他的王座时丧生，三名弑神者被碾碎在他脚下。然而，法利恩在临终之际用冰剑阿奇尔刺中了伟大神祇的膝盖。弑神者首领凯尔帝勒抓住机会，手持吸能法杖上前，对阿马克泰尔发动了骇人的一击。众神中最强大的存在就这样倒在自己的儿女手中，脸也被压进尘土。”#{normal}#

items.evidence: data/zones/reknor/grids.lua:22-47 sends the player through a swirling portal to an unfamiliar cave. The target reduces swirling portal to plain 传送门, unlike the same runtime phrase elsewhere in the corpus; the destination and no-trace clause remain accurate.
items.proposed_target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼功夫便来到一个陌生的洞穴，此间已不见传送门的踪迹……

items.evidence: data/zones/sandworm-lair/objects.lua:74-103 calls Game:chronoCancel before Wyrm Bile's permanent effects; class/Game.lua:1476-1492 clears active chronoworlds with this reason. The target accurately describes no effect on a predetermined outcome and preserves #CRIMSON#.
